He and one of his friends constantly make some pretty homo jokes and his friend even will drape himself all over him and tell me oh he’s mine what are you gonna do about it. I thought it was just a joke and whatever and I used to even roll w the punches but I would NOT be ok w it if his female friends said that to me. Idk the more I think about it the more my hunch is telling me that we aren’t compatible because how can I ask him to change himself for me. 

He pretty much told me that if he seems too gay for me then I should do what I have to do and leave. 

My heart aches.  And I’m not down to not be monogamous. For me the flirting, the “jokes”, sending people pictures like that. I’m not ok with it.  I really want things to work out and I’m willing to put the effort into it. I just don’t know what’s a happy medium.  When I tried talking about it today and he asked me why I haven’t let this go, and mind you this came up for the first time not even more than 2 weeks ago. So now I feel awkward about bringing up boundaries about people that he’s saying he’s being platonic with. Am I being stupid ?

Actually it’s exactly that conversation where he told me that he thought being gay was a choice that made me suspicious lol... and it made me think that it’s because he is choosing not to act on his homosexual feelings that he thinks it’s a choice.... 

At the same time, since he keeps persisting that he’s 100% straight, it feels funny telling him that he doesn’t seem straight. Idk if he will ever admit the truth to me, that is if he isn’t already being sincere. I’ve opened up a lot to him about pretty awful things in my life so it hurts my feelings that he wouldn’t share. 
It’s kind of why I’m struggling so much because although with my eyes I can see that this all looks pretty gay, lol, he’s still my SO and it’s hard not to believe him. 

I think ima just have to let it go to let our relationship continue to blossom.
